name: Wodac 🦕
desc:
Welcome To Wodac 🦕

Wodac is a fun survival game with a unique progression path.
The survival aspect has been simplified to make room for a fun and rewarding gameplay.


🦖 Discover Every Dinosaurs Unique Abilities

⭐ Upgrade Your Dinosaurs

📣 Invite your Friends and Make the Biggest Pack

💪 Flex Your Dinosaurs and Rare Skins

🎶 Enjoy the Unique Atmosphere and Custom Soundtracks


---
Discover a unique game in the CoS genre!, Made by a single person and maintained by a trusted team of moderators Wodac offers fun and rewarding gameplay! while keeping more mature stuff (PvP) grounded, Hope you will enjoy the game!! 
-Para402


This is a passion project of mine and we putted a lot of efforts into it.
We all hope you will enjoy the unique experience! 🧡
